title: Follow Tipper A/B entrance queue → tipper queue → hospital → exit queue flow for an AGV
summary: Verify that an AGV follows the queue/module movement sequence described for the sorter flow: entrance queue first, then tipper A/B (with its tipper queue), then hospital handling (drop-off then pickup or wait for a tote), and finally the exit queue after leaving.
when_to_use: Use when you need to confirm that an AGV’s observed movement through the sorter modules matches the intended queue-based flow: entrance queue → tipper A/B → hospital → exit queue.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Observe the AGV’s movement through the named modules/queues (entrance queue, tipper A/B, hospital drop-off/pickup/wait, exit queue) and confirm it matches the described sequence.
access_or_tools_needed: Live visibility of AGV movement through entrance queue, tipper A/B, hospital, and exit queue (site/operator observation)

system_preconditions: AGV is active enough to move through the sorter flow so its movement between entrance queue, tipper A/B, hospital, and exit queue can be observed.

visual_references.description: Modularization diagram showing Entrance Queue A/B → Tipper A/B → Tipper queue → Hospital (DropOff/Pickup/Tote) → Exit Queue.

steps.title: Identify the AGV’s tipper assignment and corresponding tip locations (tipper A and tipper B)
steps.purpose: Confirm which tipper side (A or B) the AGV is intended to use so you can validate the rest of the queue/module sequence.
steps.instruction: Using the named flow modules, identify whether the AGV is going to the Tipper A side or the Tipper B side (tip locations are tipper A and tipper B, each with its own tipper queue).
steps.expected_result: You can associate the AGV with either tipper A or tipper B (tip locations are explicitly tipper A and tipper B, and each has its own tipper queue).
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV proceeds toward the correct tipper side consistent with its tipper assignment (A vs B).
steps.failure_condition: The AGV’s observed path does not align with either tipper A or tipper B as the next tipper-side module in the described flow.

actions.label: Confirm tipper side (A vs B)
actions.exact_action: Identify whether the AGV is assigned to tipper A or tipper B (tip locations are tipper A & B).

steps.title: Observe the AGV enters via its entrance queue before tipping
steps.purpose: Validate the first stage of the described queue-based movement path.
steps.instruction: Watch the AGV’s movement and confirm it goes to its entrance queue first, before it reaches the tipper-side flow.
steps.expected_result: The AGV reaches the entrance queue first, then proceeds to the tipper-side flow after tipping is ready.
steps.healthy_condition: Entrance queue is the first observed module in the sequence for that AGV (entrance queue → tipper A/B).
steps.failure_condition: The AGV appears to reach the tipper-side module without first going through its entrance queue.

actions.label: Verify entrance queue first
actions.exact_action: Confirm the AGV goes to its entrance queue first (“it goes there first”).

steps.title: After tipping is done, observe the AGV proceeds to its tipper execute the hospitals
steps.purpose: Validate the transition from tipper-side processing to the hospital module.
steps.instruction: After the AGV completes the tipper-side tipping step, observe that it proceeds to the hospital portion of the flow (described as “tipper execute the hospitals”).
steps.expected_result: The AGV transitions from the tipper-side flow into the hospital module next.
steps.healthy_condition: No hospital bypass: the next observed module after tipping is the hospital.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV does not proceed to the hospital after tipping is complete.

actions.label: Confirm post-tipper transition to hospital
actions.exact_action: Observe the AGV goes from the tipper-side flow to the hospital (“once it’s done tipped, it goes to its tipper execute the hospitals”).

steps.title: At the hospital, observe drop-off behavior (free drop-off location → drop off → move to pickup location)
steps.purpose: Validate hospital drop-off and movement to pickup within the described hospital handling logic.
steps.instruction: At the hospital module, observe the drop-off location behavior: if the drop-off location is free, confirm the AGV drops off and then moves to its pickup location.
steps.expected_result: When the drop-off location is free, the AGV drops off and then moves to the pickup location.
steps.healthy_condition: Hospital sequence is visible as: drop-off first, then movement to pickup location.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV does not drop off when the drop-off location is free, or it does not move to the pickup location afterward.

actions.label: Check hospital drop-off then pickup movement
actions.exact_action: Observe “If the drop off location is free, it goes and then drops off, then moves to its pickup location.”

steps.title: At the hospital pickup location, observe tote-present vs tote-absent behavior (pick up vs wait)
steps.purpose: Validate the hospital pickup logic that determines whether the AGV picks up a tote or waits for one to be picked up.
steps.instruction: At the hospital pickup location, observe whether a tote is present. If a tote is present, confirm the AGV picks up; if not, confirm the AGV waits for a tote to be picked up.
steps.expected_result: If a tote is present at pickup, the AGV picks up; if not, it waits for a tote to be picked up.
steps.healthy_condition: Pickup behavior matches tote presence: pick up when available, otherwise wait.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV picks up when no tote is present, or it waits even though a tote is present at the pickup location.

actions.label: Check tote presence at hospital pickup
actions.exact_action: Observe “If a totes there, it picks up, if not, it waits for a tote to be picked up.”

steps.title: After the hospital portion completes, observe the AGV goes to its exit queue
steps.purpose: Validate the final transition in the described flow sequence.
steps.instruction: After the hospital handling completes, observe that the AGV proceeds to its exit queue (the flow described as going to the exit queue after it leaves).
steps.expected_result: The AGV moves to the exit queue after completing the hospital portion.
steps.healthy_condition: Hospital → exit queue transition occurs as the next observed module after hospital handling.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV does not proceed to the exit queue after leaving the hospital portion.

actions.label: Confirm hospital-to-exit transition
actions.exact_action: Observe “then you have your exit queue where it goes to after it leaves.”

stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV does not follow the described entrance→tipper→hospital→exit sequence.

success_criteria: Observed AGV movement matches the described sequence: entrance queue → tipper A/B (tipper queue) → hospital handling (drop-off then pickup or wait for tote) → exit queue.
healthy_conditions: AGV enters via entrance queue first, then proceeds to the correct tipper side (A or B).
After tipping, the AGV proceeds to the hospital module.
At hospital: if drop-off location is free, AGV drops off then moves to pickup location.
At hospital pickup: AGV picks up when a tote is present; otherwise it waits for a tote to be picked up.
After hospital handling, AGV proceeds to exit queue.
failure_conditions: AGV does not follow the described entrance→tipper→hospital→exit sequence.
AGV reaches tipper-side module without first going through its entrance queue.
AGV does not proceed to hospital after tipping is complete.
Hospital drop-off/pickup behavior does not match tote presence/free drop-off conditions.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate for support if the AGV does not follow the described entrance→tipper→hospital→exit sequence; the source does not provide troubleshooting steps beyond describing the intended flow.
